definitions.gloss: one pair, a pair, a matched set of two
definitions.explanation: A set of two items that go together or are designed as a matching pair.

examples.japanese: {一対|いっつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飾|かざ}る→飾る：01185_kazaru⟧。
examples.english: I display a pair of vases.

examples.japanese: ⟦イヤリング→イヤリング：04684_iyaringu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一対|いっつい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}られている→売る：00906_uru⟧。
examples.english: The earrings are sold as a pair.

examples.japanese: {一対|いっつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{狛犬|こまいぬ}→狛犬：07115_komainu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入|い}り{口|ぐち}→入り口：02507_iriguchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: A pair of guardian lion-dogs stands at the shrine entrance.

notes:
{一対|いっつい} refers to a pair of items that naturally go together.

COMMON USAGES:
- {一対|いっつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{花瓶|かびん}→花瓶：02867_kabin⟧: a pair of vases
- {一対|いっつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{狛犬|こまいぬ}→狛犬：07115_komainu⟧: a pair of komainu (guardian dogs)
- {一対|いっつい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{燭台|しょくだい}→燭台：22975_shokudai⟧: a pair of candlesticks
- {一対一|いったいいち}: one-to-one

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一対|いっつい}: a matching pair (like earrings, vases)
- {一足|いっそく}: a pair (for footwear)
- ⟦{一組|ひとくみ}→一組：26487_hitokumi⟧: a set, a pair (more general)

USAGE:
{一対|いっつい} emphasizes that two items form a matched or complementary set, often decorative items or things displayed in pairs.
